answers.core: I feel it is a fairly simple issue that causes some machines to be able to not open projects as a whole, killing work flow. Adding this would be a fix and help with older machines or people who did not know a renderer was not supported on their machine.
answers.workaround: One solution I found was to copy a projects files and then create a new project with the right renderer and paste the other project's files into that one. This however is annoying and does not save project settings, singletons, and input actions.

title: Allow for the switching of renderers in the project list
